name: Phase
description:
## Description

"A transistor-type phono equalizer amplifier developed by inheriting the design philosophy and musical expression of EA-1.The circuit configuration employs an all-stage symmetrical non-feedback amplifier.The first stage consists of a low-noise voltage-to-current conversion circuit with the complimentary service connection of a phase-correction FET (field-effect transistor). Since carefully selected elements are used and the operating point is determined by the self-bias operation, no bias circuit is required. This eliminates the inflow of noise and the deterioration factor of sound quality, enabling the original low-noise operation of the element.The second stage consists of a current amplification and voltage conversion circuit. The RIAA impedance element connected to the current output point gives the reproduction characteristics. This makes it a CR type equalizer circuit with no RIAA deviation up to the ultra-high frequency range, giving excellent transient characteristics.This circuit employs a circuit technique that achieves high precision without being affected by current variation errors and parameter variations of the amplifying element that depend on the output voltage. This circuit realizes excellent electrical characteristics comparable to those of a feedback amplifier despite being a non-feedback amplifier.The output buffer circuit uses an input bootstrap circuit to ensure high input impedance over a wide range, while the Darlington-connected output element provides sufficient current amplification and powerful drive for devices connected to the next stage.The power supply section uses an independent power transformer on the left and right and a shunt type local power supply. It provides an ideal power supply without parameter fluctuation due to power supply load, and channel separation is improved by minimizing circuit current loop.In addition, a large R-type transformer is used for the power transformer to minimize magnetic vibration and leakage flux by operating with a margin due to low magnetic flux density.The internal layout uses symmetrical dual monaural construction to achieve uniformity of the left and right channels.The power transformer is mounted directly to the brass round bar machined foot via a 5mm thick baking plate, which is an insulator with high electrical and magnetic resistance, so that the vibration generated by the power transformer is not propagated to the chassis and is directly released to the ground.The chassis structure is vibration free, resonance free and interference free.The amplifier is mounted on an electromagnetically floating sub-chassis so as not to be affected by signals other than music signals and vibration. In addition, the chassis base and top cover are plated with copper on 1.2mm and 1.6mm thick steel plates, respectively, and coated with paint to ensure rigidity and reduce magnetic distortion.The front panel is made by cutting out aluminum of 6mm thickness.Equipped with a full-fledged active subsonic filter with a cutoff frequency of 20Hz/40Hz.Machined gold plated terminals are used for input / output terminals."

## Description

"Step-up transformer for MC cartridge.A large EI core step-up transformer developed in-house is used for the transformer.Like the T-1, this transformer consists of a large EI core, the largest in its class, made of 78% super-permalloy core material 0.2mm thick, and wound with low-loss extra-thick copper side and 0.12� on the secondary side of low-loss extra-thick copper wires. 0.32As a result, a low-frequency linearity of -6dB and a high-efficiency step-up of 50% compared to conventional ones, equivalent to the T-1, have been realized.The specially divided winding structure provides broadband and excellent phase characteristics, reduces phase distortion within the audible band, and makes sound localization clearer.The step-up transformer is supported by foam polyethylene foam to prevent external vibration from propagating to the internal step-up transformer, and the casing is filled with foam polyethylene foam to prevent unnecessary cavity resonance and improve sound quality.The chassis base is 1.0mm and the cover is 1.6mm thick steel plate. It is painted on top of copper plating.It is assembled with non-magnetic screws made of stainless steel to minimize the effect of magnetostriction."

description:
## Description

"The MC cartridge was developed based on the technology and know-how accumulated in the development of the P-13series.We have succeeded in generating uniform magnetic field by our unique optimization technology of magnetic path shape, and we have realized an ideal magnetic circuit by optimizing magnetic material.In the P-1G, the magnetic circuit has been revised, and the yoke shape has been designed to have high efficiency and excellent uniformity of magnetic field. Moreover, the Permendur material constituting the magnetic circuit has the highest magnetic flux density Bm and retention force Hc among magnetic materials, and constitutes a stable magnetic field.The magnet is inherited from the samarium-cobalt magnet.DLC (Diamond Like Carbon) treatment is applied to the ground material of titanium for the base, and the probability of mechanical earth is attempted.DLC is a carbon thin film with high hardness and electrical insulation similar to diamond that is synthesized by a vapor phase synthesis method using ions. The surface hardness of DLC is higher than Hv = 3000next to diamond, and it realizes a housing base with high rigidity and excellent vibration damping characteristics.Ebony, a natural material with natural strength and damping characteristics, is used for the cartridge body, and a highly non-resonance and vibration-free structure is realized by decoding with titanium base.A wire damper has been added to reduce the microresonance and loss resistance of the lead wire from the generator coil.All parts are machined with precision machining to ensure precision and eliminate vibration from systems other than power generation systems.Solid boron material is used for the cantilever.6N oxygen-free copper wire is used for the power generation circuit.Uses pure iron coil bobbin with high saturation flux density."

## Description

"Low impedance type MC cartridge developed with non-resonance and non-vibration as the main concept.All parts of the P-3are machined with precision and DLC (Diamond Like Carbon) treated on the surface in order to ensure accuracy and thoroughly eliminate vibration other than that of the power generation system.DLC is a generic name for carbon thin films with high hardness and electrical insulation similar to diamond synthesized by vapor phase synthesis method using ions.Duralumin machined material is also used for the base that establishes mechanical grounding. The surface hardness is increased to Hv = 3000or more following diamond by DLC treatment, and the housing structure with high rigidity and excellent vibration damping characteristics is realized.The cantilever is made of solid boron material that is light and highly rigid.A power generation circuit using 6N oxygen-free copper wire is used for the power generation circuit, and a pure iron coil bobbin with high saturation flux density is used for the coil bobbin.In addition, the P-3realizes low impedance and high output by constructing a magnetic circuit using neodymium magnet. Alexandrite is highly valued as one of the Seven Jewels along with CAT'ΩS EYE. It is said to be a jewel with a face of day and a face of night because the colors are different under artificial light.It is a texture that expresses the sound quality target of P-3, and it is adopted as a compatibility because the body with DLC treatment on duralumin shaved material has the same deep luster."

description:
## Description

"Head shell made of the same material as MC Cartridge P-3.In the same way as the P-3body, DLC processing is applied to the duralumin machined material, and the surface hardness is increased to Vickers hardness Hv = 3000or more, resulting in a shell structure with high rigidity and excellent vibration damping characteristics.DLC (Diamond Like Carbon) is a generic name for carbon thin films with high hardness and electrical insulation similar to diamond synthesized by the vapor phase synthesis method using ions.The shell body and connector terminal are connected by double bolts to improve accuracy and rigidity. The rubber ring of the terminal is removed to make direct contact with the arm, and the accuracy of mechanical connection with the arm is greatly improved by two pins on the upper and lower sides.Stainless steel material is used for finger hooks.Together with the resonance dispersion shape, unnecessary resonance is suppressed.The shell lead wire uses polyurethane-coated Litz wire with as thin an insulating material as possible, and realizes sound with less noise and distortion over the entire band."
